origin.selection: rows with a loinc_code; columns labname, loinc_code, source, source_detail (the table of public lab names after eICU_MEDS #28)

lab_loinc.sources: aidh-ms/WeavEHR (MIT), commit 210a539; MIT-LCP/mimic-code (MIT), v2.4.0 (570ef01) d_labitems_to_loinc.csv; MIT-LCP/eicu-code (MIT); per-row provenance in source/source_detail

lab_loinc.notes: The lazy key stops at the first '//', exact for every lab name of the full eICU-CRD 2.0 release (none contains '//' or ends in '/'). Do not cut at the last '//': some units start with '/', so those codes would yield the name plus a trailing '/'.
